summary: Calls FreeWrapper on the object pointer stored at this[0], then calls FreeWrapper on the pointer stored at this[2] and returns its result. No guards, no globals, no branches beyond the two calls.

operations.description: Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer at this[0] (offset 0x0), releasing the first owned sub-object.
Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf on the pointer at this[2] (offset 0x8), releasing the second owned sub-object.
Return the result of the second FreeWrapper_7bcf call as the function value.

unresolved: Return value of the first FreeWrapper call is discarded while the second is returned; whether this is meaningful (e.g. first-failure propagation) is not evident.
Concrete type of 'this' and the objects at offsets 0x0 and 0x8 is unknown.
Whether the two pointers are freed unconditionally or only if non-null is hidden inside FreeWrapper_7bcf.
